subject: Post-call: Procurement path & timeline (PO vs card vs marketplace) — mutual action plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Shaw <lauren@greenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Procurement path & timeline (PO vs card vs marketplace) — mutual action plan

Hi Lauren — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps after our discovery:

Call recap:
- Primary objective: pilot Redwood inference for clinical summarization (low-PII) across 3 internal apps.
- Expected monthly token volume (pilot): ~50M tokens; target latency SLO: 200-300ms p90.
- Main procurement questions: PO vs card, marketplace route, and standard vendor paperwork (SOC 2, DPA, insurance).

What we need from Greenwave to move to procurement readiness:
1) Procurement path preference: PO (standard) vs corporate card (fast, limited spend) vs AWS Marketplace (if you want consolidated billing).
2) Procurement owner + legal contact for paperwork and contract review.
3) Any mandatory vendor form or procurement checklist you need us to complete.

Our proposed mutual action plan (calendarized):
- Aug 3 — Draft SOW and pricing finalized (owner: Rishi) [attached SOW-draft-v1.pdf]
- Aug 5–7 — Greenwave legal review + Redwood redlines (owner: Marissa)
- Aug 8–10 — Security questionnaire and evidence review (owner: Ben)
- Aug 11 — Final contract & DocuSign prepared (owner: Marissa)
- Aug 18–20 — Finance issues PO (if PO path chosen) or charge card/marketplace onboarding completed (owner: Greenwave finance)

Notes on commercial paths: 
- PO: works well for mid-sized pilots; supports invoicing and Net30 terms.
- Card: fastest, but limited spend control and manual renewals.
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP): slower onboarding but offers consolidated billing and procurement-friendly terms for enterprise IT.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf, tentative mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (summary of milestones).

As next steps, can you confirm: 1) procurement path preference, 2) procurement/finance contact, and 3) if you need any specific compliance docs up front (SOC 2, DPA, ISO)?

Thanks — I can shepherd the internal side to keep things moving.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

---
Attachment stubs: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf), mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lauren Shaw <lauren@greenwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement path & timeline (PO vs card vs marketplace) — mutual action plan

Thanks Rishi — good summary. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Preferred path: PO (Greenwave requires POs for vendor spend > $5k).
- Procurement owner: Evan Miles (cc'd here). Legal review will be handled by our in-house counsel: Claire Duval (I will introduce once we have a draft).
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, cybersecurity evidence (penetration test summary or equivalent) — if you have a one-page security snapshot that helps speed the review.

Timeline: Procurement estimates legal review ~1 week, security review ~1 week after legal flags are clear, finance aims to issue PO within 7 business days of final contract. That aligns with your schedule but may slip if our legal raises standard indemnity language changes.

I attached our internal PO template and procurement checklist — they usually want the vendor contract reviewed against these items. If you can flag any deviations up front that will help.

We are supportive of starting the pilot in August; target PO issuance date from our side would be between Aug 17–21.

Lauren
Lauren Shaw
Director, Vendor Management
Greenwave Health
lauren@greenwave.com

---
Attachment stubs: GW-PO-template-2026.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), GW-procurement-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Shaw <lauren@greenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement path & timeline (PO vs card vs marketplace) — mutual action plan

Lauren — perfect, thanks for the clarity and for looping in Evan. Couple follow-ups and commitments from our side:

What we'll deliver by Aug 5:
- Final SOW and contract draft (we'll highlight any non-standard clauses).
- One-page security snapshot + pointer to SOC 2 Type II report (Ben will assemble).
- Sample invoice and sample PO format mapping to your template.

Internal owners (for clarity):
- Marissa Cole: legal/contract shepherd and primary redlines owner (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Ben Carter: security/compliance pack (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — Ben will provide SOC 2 pointer and an executive summary of controls.

Proposed updated milestones with tentative dates (we'll iterate jointly in the MAP spreadsheet):
- Aug 3: Redwood sends final SOW & contract draft (Rishi) [SOW-draft-v1.pdf attached previously]
- Aug 5–7: Greenwave legal review (Claire) + Redwood redline session (Marissa)
- Aug 8–11: Security evidence exchange (Ben) — we can provide SOC 2 link and a short PPT on network/tenant isolation procedures
- Aug 12: Contract finalization and DocuSign prep (Marissa)
- Aug 17–21: Finance/PO issuance (Greenwave) — target PO date per Lauren note

Marketplace note (AWS): If you prefer Marketplace to avoid PO paperwork, two trade-offs: onboarding and procurement approvals can take longer initially (because of SOW entitlements and vendor registration), but post-onboarding it simplifies chargeback. If PO path is preferred, we'll prioritize the contract redlines to keep within the Aug 17 target.

Action items for Greenwave:
- Evan / Claire: confirm internal legal owner introduction (we can schedule a 30-min redline alignment call).
- Please confirm a primary finance contact for PO issuance so we can provide sample invoice fields that map to your AP system.

I'll upload the MAP sheet with owners and dates to the HubSpot record and share the link once updated.

Best,
Rishi

---
Attachment stubs: procurement_timeline_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); internal note: Ben will attach SOC 2 link in a follow-up if needed.

From: Lauren Shaw <lauren@greenwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Miles <evan.miles@greenwave.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement path & timeline (PO vs card vs marketplace) — mutual action plan

Thanks — this works. Quick confirmations:
- We'll go PO route. Evan is finance contact for issuance (evan.miles@greenwave.com).
- Claire will be looped in once you send the contract draft.
- Please send a sample invoice and the one-page security snapshot; Evan needs the invoice fields to map to our AP system.

Target: Greenwave procurement will aim to issue a PO by Aug 18 if legal sign-off completes by Aug 12. If anything shifts on our side I will flag immediately.

Appreciate the clear MAP — please share the HubSpot link and we can schedule a 30-minute redline call on Aug 6 (if that works for your legal team).

Lauren

---
Attachment stubs: GW-PO-template-2026.docx (from Lauren), GW-procurement-checklist.pdf (from Lauren)
